ninjacode.description: Frontier agentic coding for VS Code — BYOK or NinjaCode Pass
ninjacode.chatParticipant.ask: Ask a quick question (no tool access)
ninjacode.chatParticipant.agent: Run the full agent, with tool access, to make changes
ninjacode.command.inlineEdit.continueInC: NinjaCode: Continue Inline Edit in Chat
ninjacode.command.addTerminalSelectionTo: NinjaCode: Add Terminal Selection to Chat
ninjacode.viewsContainers.title: NinjaCode
ninjacode.configuration.title: NinjaCode
ninjacode.configuration.chatLocation.enu: Show chat in the Primary Side Bar (Explorer, Search, Source Control, …)
Show chat in the Secondary Side Bar (opposite the Primary Side Bar)
ninjacode.configuration.chatLocation.mar: Which VS Code side bar hosts the NinjaCode chat panel. The physical side (left or right) depends on `workbench.sideBar.location` — the Secondary Side Bar is always opposite the Primary Side Bar.
ninjacode.configuration.provider.markdow: Active connection. `gateway` is NinjaCode Pass (recommended). Other values are bring-your-own-key providers. For sign-in, credits and live model lists, open the [NinjaCode Settings tab](command:ninjacode.openSettings).
ninjacode.configuration.providers.descri: Bring-your-own-key LLM providers enabled in Settings. NinjaCode Pass is configured separately under Account.
ninjacode.configuration.favoriteModels.d: Model ids pinned to the top of the model picker
ninjacode.configuration.modelSort.descri: Sort column and direction for the model picker's Cost/Perf columns (gateway provider only)
ninjacode.configuration.localBaseUrl.des: Base URL of the local LLM server (OpenAI-compatible), e.g. Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM
ninjacode.configuration.gatewayUrl.descr: NinjaCode gateway / Pass API base URL
ninjacode.configuration.webUrl.descripti: NinjaCode website URL for browser sign-in (blank = derive from gateway URL)
ninjacode.configuration.reviewEdits.desc: Hold file edits for review before writing to disk
Reasoning effort when the selected model supports it
ninjacode.configuration.contextWindow.de: Soft context window cap in tokens (0 = use model default)
ninjacode.configuration.inlineCompletion: Show AI inline completions (ghost text) as you type
Override the model used for inline completions (blank = use the main NinjaCode model)
ninjacode.configuration.autoAcceptEditsD: Automatically accept proposed edits after this many milliseconds if none are sensitive (0 = off, requires manual review)
ninjacode.configuration.voice.model.enum: Recommended: better accuracy, still real-time on modern machines (~190 MB download)
ninjacode.configuration.voice.model.desc: Local Whisper model used for voice dictation (downloaded on first use)
ninjacode.configuration.voice.language.d: Spoken language for voice dictation (ISO 639-1 code, or "auto" to detect)
ninjacode.configuration.voice.manifestUr: Override the manifest URL used to download the voice engine and models (blank = built-in default)
ninjacode.configuration.voice.recorderCo: Override the microphone capture command for voice dictation. Must output raw 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM (s16le) on stdout. Blank = auto-detect (tries `sox`, then `ffmpeg`).
ninjacode.configuration.locale.descripti: UI language for NinjaCode chat and settings (host messages + webview)
